<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Product to check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check if first product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Withdraw" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitSplit" name="Waited more than 10 days?" default="Flow_WaitNotLong"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" name="Arrival handled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register arrived product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReadyMerge" name="Order check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReadySplit" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipSplit" name="Start courier request and packing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipJoin" name="Courier and packing completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_Withdraw">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${productInStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Reorder" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_WaitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitLong" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${waitingDays > 10}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitNotLong" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Withdraw" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CheckReady" targetRef="Gateway_ReadySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Gateway_ShipSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderReadyForShipment}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
